target: next-period excess return minus its cross-sectional mean (y_rel), decimals
features_scaling: cross-sectional ranks scaled to [-1, 1] each period; no constant
normalisation: Gamma'Gamma = I; factors orthogonal over the fit sample (sum of f f' diagonal), ordered by decreasing second moment, positive means (Kelly, Pruitt and Su 2019); applied after the fit, which leaves forecasts and kept features unchanged
schedule: every setting of the grid fitted on the training periods and scored by mean squared error on the validation periods; the chosen setting refitted once on training plus validation periods and applied unchanged to the test periods (no re-estimation inside the test period); forecast = z' Gamma lambda
